
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/sun-10387834/p/19371573" title="发布于 2025-12-30 09:39">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">【面试题】RabbitMQ 怎么实现延迟队列？</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<p>RabbitMQ 实现延迟队列主要有以下几种方式：</p>
<h2 id="1-ttl--死信队列最常用">1. <strong>TTL + 死信队列（最常用）</strong></h2>
<h3 id="原理">原理</h3>
<ul>
<li>设置消息或队列的 TTL（Time-To-Live）</li>
<li>消息过期后成为死信，转发到死信队列</li>
<li>消费者从死信队列获取延迟消息</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="实现步骤">实现步骤</h3>
<pre><code class="language-java">// 1. 创建死信交换机
channel.exchangeDeclare("dlx.exchange", "direct", true);

// 2. 创建死信队列
Map&lt;String, Object&gt; dlxArgs = new HashMap&lt;&gt;();
dlxArgs.put("x-dead-letter-exchange", "dlx.exchange");
dlxArgs.put("x-dead-letter-routing-key", "dlx.routingKey");

// 3. 创建延迟队列（设置TTL）
Map&lt;String, Object&gt; args = new HashMap&lt;&gt;();
args.put("x-message-ttl", 10000); // 10秒TTL
args.put("x-dead-letter-exchange", "dlx.exchange");
args.put("x-dead-letter-routing-key", "dlx.routingKey");
channel.queueDeclare("delay.queue", true, false, false, args);

// 4. 绑定
channel.queueBind("delay.queue", "normal.exchange", "normal.routingKey");
channel.queueBind("dlx.queue", "dlx.exchange", "dlx.routingKey");
</code></pre>
<h2 id="2-rabbitmq-delayed-message-exchange-插件推荐">2. <strong>rabbitmq-delayed-message-exchange 插件（推荐）</strong></h2>
<h3 id="安装插件">安装插件</h3>
<pre><code class="language-bash"># 下载插件（版本需匹配RabbitMQ版本）
rabbitmq-plugins enable rabbitmq_delayed_message_exchange
</code></pre>
<h3 id="使用示例">使用示例</h3>
<pre><code class="language-java">// 1. 声明延迟交换机
Map&lt;String, Object&gt; args = new HashMap&lt;&gt;();
args.put("x-delayed-type", "direct");
channel.exchangeDeclare(
    "delayed.exchange", 
    "x-delayed-message", 
    true, false, args
);

// 2. 发送延迟消息
Map&lt;String, Object&gt; headers = new HashMap&lt;&gt;();
headers.put("x-delay", 5000); // 延迟5秒

AMQP.BasicProperties.Builder props = new AMQP.BasicProperties.Builder();
props.headers(headers);

channel.basicPublish(
    "delayed.exchange", 
    "routing.key", 
    props.build(), 
    message.getBytes()
);
</code></pre>
<h2 id="3-消息级别-ttl">3. <strong>消息级别 TTL</strong></h2>
<pre><code class="language-java">// 为单条消息设置TTL
AMQP.BasicProperties properties = new AMQP.BasicProperties.Builder()
    .expiration("10000") // 10秒后过期
    .build();

channel.basicPublish(
    "exchange", 
    "routingKey", 
    properties, 
    message.getBytes()
);
</code></pre>
<h2 id="4-定时轮询数据库方案">4. <strong>定时轮询数据库方案</strong></h2>
<pre><code class="language-java">// 将延迟消息存入数据库
public void sendDelayedMessage(Message message, long delaySeconds) {
    // 计算执行时间
    Date executeTime = new Date(System.currentTimeMillis() + delaySeconds * 1000);
    // 存入数据库
    delayMessageRepository.save(message, executeTime);
    
    // 定时任务轮询
    @Scheduled(fixedDelay = 5000)
    public void processDelayedMessages() {
        List&lt;Message&gt; readyMessages = delayMessageRepository
            .findReadyMessages(new Date());
        for (Message msg : readyMessages) {
            // 发送到RabbitMQ
            rabbitTemplate.convertAndSend(msg);
        }
    }
}
</code></pre>
<h2 id="对比总结"><strong>对比总结</strong></h2>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>方案</th>
<th>优点</th>
<th>缺点</th>
<th>适用场景</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>TTL+死信队列</td>
<td>无需插件，RabbitMQ原生支持</td>
<td>1. 队列只能设置固定延迟时间<br>2. 消息级别TTL可能产生队头阻塞</td>
<td>固定延迟时间的场景</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>延迟交换机插件</td>
<td>1. 每条消息可单独设置延迟<br>2. 无队头阻塞问题</td>
<td>需要安装插件</td>
<td>灵活延迟、精确控制</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>数据库方案</td>
<td>1. 延迟时间可持久化<br>2. 支持复杂调度</td>
<td>1. 依赖外部存储<br>2. 时效性较差</td>
<td>高可靠性、长延迟场景</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<h2 id="最佳实践建议"><strong>最佳实践建议</strong></h2>
<ol>
<li><strong>短延迟（秒/分钟级）</strong>：使用延迟交换机插件</li>
<li><strong>固定延迟</strong>：使用TTL+死信队列</li>
<li><strong>长延迟（小时/天级）</strong>：使用数据库+定时任务</li>
<li><strong>高精度延迟</strong>：结合Redis有序集合</li>
</ol>
<pre><code class="language-yaml"># Spring Boot 配置示例
spring:
  rabbitmq:
    host: localhost
    port: 5672
  # 延迟交换机插件支持
  rabbitmq:
    delayed:
      exchange:
        enabled: true
</code></pre>
<p>选择方案时需考虑：延迟精度、消息量、系统复杂度、是否需要持久化等因素。</p>

</div>
